statements.quote: We are confident about the opportunities ahead, and to accelerate our progress, we expect to invest approximately $75 billion in capital expenditures in 2025.
statements.notes: This is total 2025 capex guidance. The sentence does not name AI; 'our progress' refers back to the preceding sentence about the 'full-stack approach to AI innovation' and core businesses. Recorded as scope total so the figure is not read as AI spend.

statements.quote: These costs primarily include certain AI-focused shared R&D activities, including development costs of our general AI models; corporate initiatives such as our philanthropic activities; corporate shared costs such as certain finance, human resource, and legal costs, including certain fines and settlements.
statements.notes: Segment-reporting description of unallocated Alphabet-level costs, which include AI-focused shared R&D (general AI model development). 'Primarily' covers the whole list, not AI R&D alone, so this does not establish what share is AI. It may be closer to accounting boilerplate than a spend statement. No year named; code defaults to fiscal 2024.
